title: Lost a Knife, Found a Shell

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — GOOD, BAD AND ORDINARY DAYS (DAY-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Wonderful days, rotten days, mixed days and days when nothing much happens at all. Moods come without reasons, small things matter more than they should, and nobody has to end the day happier, wiser or more productive than they started it.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an adult)

collection.description: Searching for a lost knife, a villager finds a beautiful shell instead: keep looking for the knife, or call it even.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has lost (subject.his/her) good little knife. (subject.He/she) has looked everywhere: the hut, the garden, the path to the stream. While searching along the sand (subject.he/she) hasn't found the knife, but (subject.he/she) has found the most beautiful shell (subject.he/she) has ever seen: pink and gold, curled like a fern. (subject.He/she) is standing on the beach holding it, still knifeless.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) decides a beautiful shell is a fair trade for a lost knife. (subject.He/she) borrows a knife from (friend), and puts the shell on the shelf. Two days later the knife turns up under the sleeping mat. Now (subject.he/she) has both, and (subject.he/she) feels as if (subject.he/she) has somehow cheated the island.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: (subject) puts the shell in (subject.his/her) pocket and keeps looking. (subject.He/she) finds the knife at sunset, in the water jar, where (subject.he/she) put it that morning. (subject.He/she) has the knife and the shell. That's a good day, in the end, even if (subject.he/she) spent most of it annoyed.
